name: The Deserters
summary: At Lost Point, Captain Garran Vimes questions deserters who took Theramore’s abandoned tower.

sections.title: A Tower Taken
sections.body: Captain Garran Vimes struggles to hold the marsh, yet his people keep several watchtowers standing. Scouts have found deserters in an abandoned tower at Lost Point, southeast of the inn. A man named Jacken leads them. Vimes asks you to learn what Jacken knows about Reethe, though the man may not give up the information easily.

faq.q: Who sends you to deal with the deserters?
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes sends you. His scouts report deserters have settled in a tower Theramore abandoned.
The deserters are hiding at Lost Point, southeast of the inn, in an abandoned tower in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: Who leads the deserters at Lost Point?
faq.answer: A man called Jacken, also known as Balos Jacken, leads the deserters. Vimes warns that Jacken may not give up information easily.

faq.q: What does Captain Vimes want from Balos Jacken?
faq.answer: Captain Vimes wants information about Reethe from Balos Jacken and the deserters.
